# robots.txt for https://www.prap.co.jp/
# Updated to align with llms.txt guidance (PRAP corporate site + recruit content + external IR site)
# Focus:
# - Block WP internals
# - Avoid crawling internal search result URLs
# - Avoid crawling form endpoints / thank-you pages (lead-gen, personal data)
# - Reduce crawl load from large volumes of PDFs under /topics/wp-content/uploads/
#
# Last-Reviewed: 2026-02-10

User-agent: *

# --- WordPress admin / internals (standard hardening) ---
Disallow: /wp/wp-admin/
Allow: /wp/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php
Disallow: /wp/wp-login.php
Disallow: /wp/wp-json/
Disallow: /wp/wp-includes/

# --- Internal search results (WordPress-style query) ---
Disallow: /?s=
Disallow: /*?s=
Disallow: /*&s=

# --- Lead-gen / inquiry forms & thank-you pages (avoid indexing/crawling) ---
# PR inquiry / document requests / newsletters
Disallow: /pr/contact
Disallow: /pr/contact/
Disallow: /pr/contact_con
Disallow: /pr/contact/documents
Disallow: /pr/contact/request_thanks
Disallow: /pr/contact/newsletter
Disallow: /pr/contact/newsletter/thanks

# Recruit / other inquiries (forms)
Disallow: /contact/recruit/
Disallow: /contact/etc/

# Service-specific document request forms (pattern)
Disallow: /pr/service/*document-request

# --- PDF crawl reduction (majority of PDFs are stored under /topics/wp-content/uploads/...) ---
# Note: keep this ON only if you do NOT need PDF SEO/indexing.
Disallow: /topics/wp-content/uploads/*.pdf$

# --- Sitemaps (keep the one your CMS actually serves) ---
